caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a vivid red color and four ornately turned legs. The tabletop has a rectangular shape with one end raised higher than the other, creating an asymmetrical profile. The body and legs of the table are shaded with variations of red to suggest grain and dimensionality. The main image of the table is centered within a rectangular frame on a beige or off-white background. Below the main colored rendering, there are three technical line drawings of the table—one on the left, one in the center, and one on the right. Each of these technical drawings displays different views (side and front profiles) of the table, and they are annotated with measurements. The word “MEYERS” appears beneath the leftmost technical drawing.
title: Writing Desk and Table
